summary.description: What the change does, how much of it was covered, and anything left out. Never a tally by severity and never a restatement of a finding.

findings.description: Every defect above the bar, and nothing else. Empty when the change has none.

severity.description: P1 breaks something, P2 is owed by a rule, P3 is paid for later.

path.description: A key of lines.json, or null for the one finding that has no line.

start_line.description: The first line of a range, or null when the finding sits on one line.

line.description: One of the numbers lines.json lists for path, or null when path is null.

title.description: Imperative, naming the correction in a handful of words.

impact.description: The input or state that reaches this code, and the wrong result that follows.

correction.description: The smallest change that fixes it, and nothing else.

rule.description: The file and its section, or the specification or ADR, that the finding rests on.
